nissan.name: Nissan
nissan.description: Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. It sells vehicles under the Nissan and Infiniti brands and has in-house performance tuning products under the Nismo and Autech brands.

nippon-steel-corporation.name: Nippon Steel Corporation
nippon-steel-corporation.description: Nippon Steel Corporation is a Japanese steel manufacturing company headquartered in Tokyo. It operates in steelmaking, engineering, chemicals, and systems solutions, and is the largest producer of crude steel in Japan and the fourth largest worldwide.

nike.name: Nike
nike.description: Nike, Inc. is an American athletic footwear and apparel corporation headquartered near Beaverton, Oregon. It is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment.

nornickel.name: Nornickel
nornickel.description: Norilsk Nickel, or Nornickel, is a Russian nickel and palladium mining and smelting company. Its largest operations are near the Yenisei River in Siberia, with additional holdings in Finland, South Africa, and the Kola Peninsula.

nordstrom.name: Nordstrom
nordstrom.description: Nordstrom, Inc. is an American upmarket department store chain headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1901 as a shoe store, it expanded into clothing and off-price retailing, operating full-line and off-price divisions across the United States.

nordea.name: Nordea
nordea.description: Nordea Bank Abp is a Nordic financial services group headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. It operates in northern Europe and is listed on Nasdaq Nordic exchanges in Helsinki, Copenhagen, and Stockholm, with American Depository Receipts traded in the US. The company exited several markets including Poland, the Baltics, and Russia.

nucor.name: Nucor
nucor.description: Nucor Corporation is an American steel producer based in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of scrap in North America. Nucor is also one of the two primary suppliers of rebar used in U.S. infrastructure.

nippon-sheet-glass.name: Nippon Sheet Glass
nippon-sheet-glass.description: Nippon Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. is a Japanese glass manufacturing company. It acquired Pilkington in 2006, making it one of the four largest glass companies globally alongside Asahi Glass, Saint-Gobain, and Guardian Industries.

ntt-docomo.name: NTT DoCoMo
ntt-docomo.description: NTT Docomo, Inc. is a Japanese mobile telecommunications carrier and subsidiary of NTT. The company is headquartered in the Sanno Park Tower in Nagatachō, Chiyoda, Tokyo. It operates as a joint-stock corporation under Japan's Companies Act.

nexans.name: Nexans
nexans.description: Nexans S.A. is a global company in the cable and optical fibre industry headquartered in Paris, France. It specializes in manufacturing cables and related products for various applications worldwide.

ncr-corporation.name: NCR Corporation
ncr-corporation.description: NCR Voyix Corporation, formerly NCR Corporation, is a global software, consulting, and technology company based in the United States. It produces self-service kiosks, point-of-sale software and terminals, check processing systems, thermal printers, and barcode scanners.

northern-trust.name: Northern Trust
northern-trust.description: Northern Trust Corporation is an American financial services company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It serves corporations, institutional investors, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Northern Trust is one of the largest and oldest banks in the United States.

neusoft.name: Neusoft
neusoft.description: Neusoft Corporation is a Chinese multinational provider of software engineering, IT services, product engineering, IT education, and medical equipment. It is headquartered in Shenyang, China.

newell-brands.name: Newell Brands
newell-brands.description: Newell Brands Inc. is an American conglomerate producing consumer and commercial products. Its brands include Rubbermaid storage containers, Contigo water bottles, Coleman outdoor products, and various writing instruments and cookware.

nexstar-media-group.name: Nexstar Media Group
nexstar-media-group.description: Nexstar Media Group, Inc. is an American multimedia conglomerate headquartered in Irving, Texas, with additional offices in Manhattan and Chicago. Founded in 1996, it is the largest television broadcasting company in the U.S., owning 265 television stations affiliated with major networks and operating others through local marketing agreements.

netapp.name: NetApp
netapp.description: NetApp, Inc. is an American data infrastructure company based in San Jose, California. Founded in 1992, it provides unified data storage, integrated data services, and cloud operations solutions. It was ranked in the Fortune 500 from 2012 to 2021.

nis.name: NIS
nis.description: Naftna Industrija Srbije (NIS) is a Serbian multinational oil and gas company headquartered in Novi Sad, Serbia. It is one of the most profitable companies in Serbia and a major domestic exporter. Gazprom Neft is the largest shareholder, owning 44.85% of NIS shares.

netease.name: NetEase
netease.description: NetEase, Inc. is a Chinese Internet technology company founded in 1997 by Ding Lei. Its businesses include video games, news aggregation, music streaming, advertising, email, and e-commerce.

nrg-energy.name: NRG Energy
nrg-energy.description: NRG Energy, Inc. is an American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It is involved in energy generation and retail electricity, with a portfolio including natural gas, coal, oil, nuclear, wind, and solar generation.

nasdaq-inc.name: Nasdaq, Inc.
nasdaq-inc.description: Nasdaq, Inc. is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1971 as the world's first electronic stock market, it provides data, analytics, software, exchange capabilities, and advisory services globally. Its CEO and chair is Adena Friedman.

novonesis.name: Novonesis
novonesis.description: Novonesis is a biotechnology company formed in January 2024 by the merger of Novozymes A/S and Chr. Hansen. It is based in Bagsværd, Greater Copenhagen, Denmark. The company focuses on industrial enzymes, microorganisms, and biopharmaceutical ingredients.

naturgy.name: Naturgy
naturgy.description: Naturgy Energy Group S.A. is a Spanish multinational company operating in natural gas and electrical energy utilities. It primarily operates in Spain and has its administrative headquarters in Madrid.

nippon-chemi-con.name: Nippon Chemi-Con
nippon-chemi-con.description: Nippon Chemi-Con Corporation is a Japanese company that produces capacitors and other discrete electronic components. It operates in the electronics industry and is based in Japan.

national-instruments.name: National Instruments
national-instruments.description: National Instruments, now known as NI, is an American multinational company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It produces automated test equipment, semiconductor production equipment, and virtual instrumentation software. Since October 2023, it operates as Emerson Electric's test and measurement business unit.

nachi-fujikoshi.name: Nachi-Fujikoshi
nachi-fujikoshi.description: Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. is a Japanese company known for producing industrial robots, machining tools, systems, and machine components. It operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

nabil-bank-limited.name: Nabil Bank Limited
nabil-bank-limited.description: Nabil Bank Limited, formerly Nepal Arab Bank Limited, is the first foreign joint venture commercial bank in Nepal, established in 1984. It offers a wide range of commercial banking services and operates an extensive network of branches, ATMs, and correspondent banking relationships.

nacco-industries.name: NACCO Industries
nacco-industries.description: NACCO Industries, Inc. is an American holding company headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio. It operates through mining and natural resources businesses in three segments: Coal Mining, North American Mining, and Minerals Management. The company also provides stream and wetland mitigation solutions.

nextgen-healthcare-information-systems.name: NextGen Healthcare Information Systems
nextgen-healthcare-information-systems.description: NextGen Healthcare, Inc. is an American software and services company headquartered in Irvine, California. It develops and sells electronic health record software and practice management systems for medical and dental practices. The company was formerly known as Quality Systems, Inc.

nissan-chemical.name: Nissan Chemical
nissan-chemical.description: Nissan Chemical Corporation is a Japanese chemical company and a constituent of the Nikkei 225 stock index. It operates in the chemical industry and is based in Japan.

navneet-publications.name: Navneet Publications
navneet-publications.description: Navneet Education Limited is an Indian company engaged in educational and children book publishing, scholastic stationery, and non-paper stationery products. It operates in the stationery industry and is based in India.

nnit.name: NNIT
nnit.description: NNIT A/S is a Danish IT company providing consultancy, development, implementation, and outsourcing of IT services. It serves clients within life sciences and other sectors both in Denmark and internationally.

nordic-semiconductor.name: Nordic Semiconductor
nordic-semiconductor.description: Nordic Semiconductor ASA is a Norwegian fabless technology company headquartered in Trondheim, Norway. Founded in 1983, it specializes in ultra-low-power wireless communication semiconductors and software for Internet of Things product development.

nature-s-sunshine-products.name: Nature's Sunshine Products
nature-s-sunshine-products.description: Nature's Sunshine Products, Inc. is a manufacturer of dietary supplements including herbs, vitamins, minerals, and personal care products. It is based in Lehi, Utah, with a manufacturing facility in Spanish Fork, Utah.

nepal-sbi-bank-limited.name: Nepal SBI Bank Limited
nepal-sbi-bank-limited.description: Nepal SBI Bank Limited is the first Indo-Nepal joint venture in the financial sector. It was established through a memorandum of understanding signed on 17 July 1992 by the State Bank of India, Employees Provident Fund, and Agricultural Development Bank of Nepal.

netgear.name: Netgear
netgear.description: Netgear, Inc. is an American computer networking company based in San Jose, California, with offices in about 22 countries. It produces networking hardware for consumers, businesses, and service providers, operating in retail, commercial, and service provider segments.

nextdoor.name: Nextdoor
nextdoor.description: Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. is an American company operating a hyperlocal social networking service for neighborhoods. Founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, California, it launched in the US in 2011 and is available in eleven countries as of 2023.

nova-ltd.name: Nova Ltd.
nova-ltd.description: Nova Ltd., formerly Nova Measuring Instruments, is an Israeli publicly traded company founded in 1993 that provides advanced metrology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. It specializes in dimensional, materials, and chemical metrology technologies and is listed on NASDAQ and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

norwegian-air-shuttle.name: Norwegian Air Shuttle
norwegian-air-shuttle.description: Norwegian Air Shuttle ASA, trading as Norwegian, is a Norwegian low-cost airline and Scandinavia's second-largest airline. It operates a high-frequency domestic flight schedule within Scandinavia and Finland, as well as to business and holiday destinations in Europe. The airline is known for its distinctive livery featuring portraits on the tail fins of its aircraft.

nokian-panimo.name: Nokian Panimo
nokian-panimo.description: Nokian Panimo Oy is a brewery based in Nokia, Finland, founded in 1991. It produces beer, cider, mineral water, and soft drinks. The company operates in the food industry.

nel.name: Nel
nel.industry: Manufacture of other special-purpose machinery n.e.c.
nel.description: Nel ASA is a Norwegian company founded in 1927 and based in Oslo. It provides solutions for the production, storage, and distribution of hydrogen from renewable energy sources. Nel is listed in the OBX Index of the Oslo Stock Exchange.

ntt-data-group.name: NTT Data Group
ntt-data-group.description: NTT DATA Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational IT service and consulting company headquartered in Tokyo. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone (NTT). The company operates in the information technology consulting industry.

ntt-inc.name: NTT, Inc.
ntt-inc.description: NTT, Inc. is a Japanese telecommunications holding company headquartered in Tokyo. It is one of the largest telecommunications companies globally by revenue and market capitalization, with a history of being the world's largest company by market cap in the late 1980s.

nok-air.name: Nok Air
nok-air.description: Nok Airlines plc, trading as Nok Air, is a low-cost airline based in Thailand. It primarily operates domestic flights from Bangkok's Don Mueang International Airport.

nippon-paper-industries.name: Nippon Paper Industries
nippon-paper-industries.description: Nippon Paper Industries Co., Ltd. is a Japanese paper manufacturing company. Its stock is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

newegg.name: Newegg
newegg.description: Newegg Commerce, Inc. is an American online retailer headquartered in Diamond Bar, California. Founded in 2001 by Fred Chang, it specializes in computer hardware, consumer electronics, and related technology products. It is known for its focus on technology enthusiasts and PC builders.

new-world-department-store-china-limited.name: New World Department Store China Limited
new-world-department-store-china-limited.legal_name: New World Department Store China Limited
new-world-department-store-china-limited.description: New World Department Store China Limited is a Hong Kong–based holding company for department store chains in Mainland China. It operates stores under the brands "New World" and Ba-li Chun-tian and is a subsidiary of New World Development. The chairman is Henry Cheng, son of billionaire Cheng Yu-tung.

listings.name: New World Department Store China Limited

new-china-life-insurance-co-ltd.name: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
new-china-life-insurance-co-ltd.legal_name: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
new-china-life-insurance-co-ltd.description: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd. is a Chinese life insurance company based in Beijing. The Chinese government owns more than half of its shares through sovereign fund Central Huijin and state-owned enterprises Baosteel Group and China Securities Finance.

listings.name: New China Life Insurance Co., Ltd.

nippon-television-holdings.name: Nippon Television Holdings
nippon-television-holdings.description: Nippon Television Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese media and broadcasting holding company headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It includes Nippon Television, Japan's first commercial broadcaster, and owns shares in animation and film studios. The company is partially controlled by The Yomiuri Shimbun Holdings, Japan's largest media conglomerate.

nabtesco.name: Nabtesco
nabtesco.description: Nabtesco is a Japanese engineering company specializing in gearboxes, rotors, motors, and robotics. It operates in the industrial engineering sector.

narumiya-international.name: Narumiya International
narumiya-international.description: Narumiya International is a Japanese company headquartered in Minato Ward, Tokyo, that manufactures and distributes textiles. It specializes in children's clothing.

nipro.name: Nipro
nipro.description: Nipro Corporation is a Japanese medical equipment manufacturing company founded in 1954 and headquartered in Osaka. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Osaka Securities Exchange.

netdragon-websoft.name: NetDragon Websoft
netdragon-websoft.description: NetDragon Websoft is a Chinese company that develops and operates massively multiplayer online games and creates mobile applications. The company launched its first product in 2002.

nuance-communications.name: Nuance Communications
nuance-communications.description: Nuance Communications, Inc. was an American multinational computer software technology corporation headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. It marketed speech recognition and artificial intelligence software.

nippon-ichi-software.name: Nippon Ichi Software
nippon-ichi-software.description: Nippon Ichi Software, Inc. is a Japanese video game developer and publisher founded in 1991. It is known for developing role-playing video games such as the Disgaea and Marl Kingdom series. The company’s mascot is the penguin-like character Prinny from Disgaea.

ns-solutions.name: NS Solutions
ns-solutions.description: NS Solutions Corp. is a Japanese company based in Tokyo that provides IT services, system integration, cloud computing, and information security. It operates within the information technology sector in Japan.

nippon-filcon.name: Nippon Filcon
nippon-filcon.description: Nippon Filcon is a Japanese manufacturing company established in 1936. It operates in the pulp and paper industry in Japan.

nkk-switches.name: NKK switches
nkk-switches.description: NKK SWITCHES Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that designs and manufactures a variety of industrial operational switches. Their products include illuminated, process sealed, miniature, and programmable switches among others.

newsmax-media.name: Newsmax Media
newsmax-media.description: Newsmax, Inc. is an American cable news, political opinion commentary, and digital media company founded in 1998 by Christopher Ruddy. It operates divisions including Newsmax TV, Newsmax.com, and Newsmax magazine. The company went public in March 2025.

noah-holdings.name: Noah Holdings
noah-holdings.description: Noah Holdings is a Chinese financial services company headquartered in Shanghai. It is recognized as the largest independent wealth management company in China.

nikon.name: Nikon
nikon.description: Nikon Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of optical and precision equipment headquartered in Tokyo. Its products include cameras, lenses, semiconductor lithography systems, microscopes, and industrial measurement equipment.

national-shipping-company-of-saudi-arabi.name: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
national-shipping-company-of-saudi-arabi.legal_name: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
national-shipping-company-of-saudi-arabi.description: Bahri, formerly known as the National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, is a transportation and logistics company serving as the national shipping carrier of Saudi Arabia. It is based in Saudi Arabia and plays a key role in the country's shipping industry.

listings.name: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia

nadec.name: Nadec
nadec.description: The National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec) is a major agricultural and food-processing joint stock company in the Middle East and North Africa. Established in 1981 by royal decree, it is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy businesses globally and is partly owned by the Saudi government.

ngk.name: Ngk
ngk.description: NGK Corporation is a Japanese ceramics company headquartered in Tokyo. It primarily produces insulators and other ceramic products. Established in 1919 as a spin-off from Nippon Toki, it is listed on multiple Japanese stock exchanges.

namyang-dairy-products.name: Namyang Dairy Products
namyang-dairy-products.description: Namyang Dairy Products is a South Korean food and dairy corporation headquartered in Seoul. It is one of the largest dairy manufacturers in South Korea, alongside Seoul Milk and Maeil Holdings. The company operates in the agriculture and food sector.

nomura-holdings.name: Nomura Holdings
nomura-holdings.description: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company and principal member of the Nomura Group, Japan's largest investment bank and brokerage group. It provides investment, financing, and related services globally through its broker-dealer, banking, and other financial subsidiaries.

natura-co.name: Natura & Co
natura-co.description: Natura Cosméticos S.A. is a Brazilian global personal care cosmetics group headquartered in São Paulo. It includes the Natura brand and Avon Products, operates in 73 countries, and became the 4th largest pure-play beauty company after acquiring Avon.

nmb-bank-nepal.name: NMB Bank Nepal
nmb-bank-nepal.description: NMB Bank Nepal is a commercial bank headquartered in Kathmandu, Nepal. Licensed by the Nepal Rastra Bank, it operates 202 branches nationwide providing retail and commercial banking services.

nepal-investment-bank-limited.name: Nepal Investment Bank Limited
nepal-investment-bank-limited.description: Nepal Investment Mega Bank Limited is a leading commercial bank in Nepal, established in 1986 as a joint venture with Credit Agricole Indosuez. It became fully Nepalese-owned in 2001 and merged with Mega Bank Nepal in 2023, operating under its current name since January 2023.

nathan-s-famous.name: Nathan's Famous
nathan-s-famous.description: Nathan's Famous, Inc. is an American fast-food company specializing in hot dogs. Its original restaurant is located in Coney Island, Brooklyn, New York City, and its headquarters are in Jericho, New York. The chain primarily operates in the Northeastern United States.

natwest-group.name: NatWest Group
natwest-group.description: NatWest Group plc is a British banking and insurance holding company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It operates multiple banking brands including National Westminster Bank and Royal Bank of Scotland, and issues banknotes in Scotland and Northern Ireland.

neuland-laboratories.name: Neuland Laboratories
neuland-laboratories.description: Neuland Laboratories Limited is an Indian contract development and manufacturing organization headquartered in Hyderabad. Founded in 1984, it produces active pharmaceutical ingredients, advanced intermediates, and peptide APIs. The company is publicly traded on Indian stock exchanges.

nippn.name: Nippn
nippn.description: Nippn Corporation is a Japanese company primarily engaged in milling flour and producing flour-related products such as noodles. Established in 1896, it is part of the Mitsui keiretsu. The company operates within Japan's food industry.

nrj-group.name: NRJ Group
nrj-group.description: The NRJ Group is a French multimedia group based in Paris. Founded in 1981 by Jean-Paul Baudecroux and Max Guazzini, it started as a French pop music radio station and has since evolved into a broader multimedia company.

news-corp.name: News Corp
news-corp.description: News Corporation, known as News Corp, is an American mass media and publishing company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Formed in 2013 as a spin-off of the first News Corporation, it operates across digital real estate, news media, book publishing, and cable television. Notable assets include Dow Jones & Company and HarperCollins.

natural-alternatives-international.name: Natural Alternatives International
natural-alternatives-international.description: Natural Alternatives International, Inc. is an American company based in Carlsbad, California that manufactures nutritional supplements such as Juice Plus. Founded in 1980, it operates manufacturing facilities in Vista, California, Switzerland, and Japan.

netlist-inc.name: Netlist Inc.
netlist-inc.description: Netlist, Inc. is a Delaware-registered corporation headquartered in Irvine, California. It designs and sells high-performance SSDs and modular memory subsystems to enterprise customers and holds patents in server memory and storage technologies. The company trades on the OTCQB market.

newbridge-bank.name: NewBridge Bank
newbridge-bank.description: NewBridge Bank was a banking company based in Greensboro, North Carolina, with branches in North Carolina and Virginia. It was formed from the merger of Lexington State Bank and FNB Southeast in 2007 and was the banking subsidiary of NewBridge Bancorp. The bank no longer operates under that name.

noble-group.name: Noble Group
noble-group.description: Noble Resources Trading Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based commodity trader dealing in energy products and industrial raw materials. Its predecessor, Noble Group Ltd, faced an accounting fraud controversy starting in 2015, leading to a debt restructuring.

noritake.name: Noritake
noritake.description: Noritake Co., Limited is a Japanese manufacturer of porcelain, fine ceramics, and sharpening stones headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

nutanix.name: Nutanix
nutanix.description: Nutanix, Inc. is an American cloud computing company based in San Jose, California. It develops software for datacenters and hybrid multi-cloud deployments.

nci-building-systems.name: NCI Building Systems
nci-building-systems.description: Cornerstone Building Brands, Inc. was formed from the merger of NCI Building Systems, Inc. and Ply Gem Parent, LLC in 2018. Headquartered in Cary, North Carolina, it is the largest manufacturer of exterior building products in North America serving commercial, residential, and repair markets.

nine-entertainment-co.name: Nine Entertainment Co.
nine-entertainment-co.description: Nine Entertainment Co. Holdings Limited is an Australian publicly listed company with holdings in mass media, including radio and television broadcasting, publishing, and digital media. It uses Nine as its corporate branding. The company is based in Australia.

nick-scali-furniture.name: Nick Scali Furniture
nick-scali-furniture.description: Nick Scali Limited is a publicly listed Australian company that imports and retails furniture such as lounge suites, dining tables, and chairs. It was founded in 1962 by Nick D. Scali.

national-research-corporation.name: National Research Corporation
national-research-corporation.description: National Research Corporation, known as NRC Health, is an American healthcare company based in Lincoln, Nebraska. It provides healthcare products and subscription-based solutions in the US and Canada. The company was founded in 1981 and changed its name to NRC Health in 2026.

north-valley-bancorp.name: North Valley Bancorp
north-valley-bancorp.description: North Valley Bancorp was a bank holding company headquartered in Redding, California. It operated 22 branches before being acquired by TriCo Bancshares in 2014. The company was part of the banking industry in the United States.

novavax.name: Novavax
novavax.description: Novavax, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in Gaithersburg, Maryland. It develops vaccines to counter infectious diseases, including the Novavax COVID-19 vaccine now commercialized by Sanofi. The company also works on vaccines for influenza, RSV, avian flu, shingles, Clostridioides difficile, and malaria.

network-18.name: Network 18
network-18.description: Network18 Media & Investments Limited is an Indian media conglomerate owned by Reliance Industries, with a 56.89% share. The company is led by managing director and CEO Rahul Joshi and chairman Adil Zainulbhai.

newpark-resources.name: Newpark Resources
newpark-resources.description: Newpark Resources, Inc. is a worldwide provider of drilling fluids systems and composite matting systems used in oilfield and commercial markets. Founded in 1932, it is based in The Woodlands, Texas. The company partners with industry organizations like the American Petroleum Institute.

nektar-therapeutics.name: Nektar Therapeutics
nektar-therapeutics.description: Nektar Therapeutics is an American biopharmaceutical company based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 1990, it develops drug candidates using proprietary PEGylation and polymer conjugate technologies. It developed Exubera, the world's first inhalable non-injectable insulin.

national-rural-utilities-cooperative-fin.name: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation
national-rural-utilities-cooperative-fin.legal_name: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation
national-rural-utilities-cooperative-fin.description: The National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation (CFC) is a member-owned nonprofit cooperative in the United States. Established in 1969, it provides financial products to rural electric cooperatives and supplements USDA loan programs for these cooperatives.

listings.name: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation

natural-grocers.name: Natural Grocers
natural-grocers.description: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. is a health food retail chain based in Colorado, United States. It operates in the retail sector focusing on health food products.

ncc-group.name: NCC Group
ncc-group.description: NCC Group is an information assurance firm based in Manchester, United Kingdom. It provides cyber security consulting and managed services to over 15,000 clients worldwide. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

newmarket-corporation.name: NewMarket Corporation
newmarket-corporation.description: NewMarket Corporation is a publicly traded American company serving the petroleum additives industry. Based in Richmond, Virginia, it operates across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. Its predecessor was founded in 1887.

nu-skin-enterprises.name: Nu Skin Enterprises
nu-skin-enterprises.description: Nu Skin Enterprises, Inc. is an American multilevel marketing company that develops and sells personal care products and dietary supplements. Founded in 1984, it operates under the Nu Skin and Pharmanex brands and sells products in 54 markets through about 1.2 million independent distributors.

novolipetsk-steel.name: Novolipetsk Steel
novolipetsk-steel.description: Novolipetsk Steel (NLMK) is one of Russia's four largest steel companies, producing flat steel, semi-finished steel, electrical steels, and specialty coated steels. It is the 21st-largest steel maker globally and owns several steel and mining companies primarily in Russia.

newmont-mining-corporation.name: Newmont Mining Corporation
newmont-mining-corporation.description: Newmont Corporation is an American gold mining company based in Denver, Colorado. Incorporated in 1921, it owns gold mines across multiple countries and also mines copper, silver, zinc, and lead. It is the world's largest gold mining corporation.

national-oilwell-varco.name: National Oilwell Varco
national-oilwell-varco.description: NOV, formerly National Oilwell Varco, is an American multinational corporation based in Houston, Texas. It provides equipment and components for oil and gas drilling and production, oilfield services, and supply chain integration to the upstream oil and gas industry worldwide.

neles.name: Neles
neles.description: Neles Oyj was a Finnish publicly traded company offering flow control products and services for process industries. It originated from the Neles trademark filed in 1956 by Finnish engineers. The company started operations on July 1, 2020, after the transformation of the remaining Metso following a merger.

nsk-ltd.name: NSK Ltd.
nsk-ltd.description: NSK Ltd., also known as NSK Automation in some markets, is a major Japanese manufacturer of bearings. It produces industrial machinery bearings, precision machinery parts, and automotive bearings and components. NSK is the largest bearing manufacturer in Japan.

nabors-industries.name: Nabors Industries
nabors-industries.description: Nabors Industries Limited is an American global oil and gas drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas. It owns the world's second largest land drilling rig fleet with over 250 rigs operating in 20 countries. The company operates in the oil and gas industry.

natco-pharma.name: Natco Pharma
natco-pharma.description: Natco Pharma is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad. It manufactures finished dosage formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and agrochemical products. The company is a major producer of branded oncology, cardiology, diabetology, and other specialty drugs at affordable prices.

nisource.name: NiSource
nisource.description: NiSource Inc. is a fully regulated utility company based in Merrillville, Indiana, United States. It serves natural gas and electric customers across six states through its Columbia Gas and NIPSCO brands and is the sole Indiana-based utility company as of 2018.

navient.name: Navient
navient.description: Navient Corporation is an American financial services company based in Herndon, Virginia. Formed in 2014 from the split of Sallie Mae, it serviced a quarter of all US student loans in 2018 but was barred from servicing federal student loans in 2024.

nilesat.name: Nilesat
nilesat.description: Nilesat, or Egyptian Satellites Co SAE, is an Egyptian company established in 1996 to operate communications satellites and related ground stations. It is listed on the Egyptian Exchange and majority-controlled by the Egyptian government.

nordson-corporation.name: Nordson Corporation
nordson-corporation.description: Nordson Corporation is an American multinational headquartered in Westlake, Ohio. It designs and manufactures dispensing equipment for adhesives and coatings, as well as equipment for testing electronic components and medical devices.

nordic-investment-bank.name: Nordic Investment Bank
nordic-investment-bank.description: The Nordic Investment Bank is an international financial institution founded in 1975 by the five Nordic countries. Its headquarters are in Helsinki, Finland. The bank acquires funds for lending by borrowing on international capital markets.

northern-tier-energy.name: Northern Tier Energy
northern-tier-energy.description: Northern Tier Energy LP was an American downstream energy limited partnership that owned the SuperAmerica gas station chain, an oil refinery in St. Paul Park, Minnesota, and an interest in a pipeline. It was ranked 525 on the Fortune 1000 in 2014.

nextera-energy-partners.name: NextEra Energy Partners
nextera-energy-partners.description: XPLR Infrastructure is a publicly traded subsidiary of NextEra Energy, a renewable energy company based in Juno Beach, Florida, United States.

norfolk-southern-corporation.name: Norfolk Southern Corporation
norfolk-southern-corporation.description: Norfolk Southern Railway is a Class I freight railroad operating in the Eastern United States, headquartered in Atlanta. Formed in 1982 by merging Norfolk and Western Railway and Southern Railway, it operates over 19,000 route miles in 22 states and the District of Columbia.

national-storage.name: National Storage
national-storage.description: National Storage is an Australian and New Zealand self-storage provider operating over 200 centres. It offers residential and commercial storage solutions. The company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 2013 as National Storage REIT, the first publicly listed independent self-storage owner and operator in Australia.

nec.name: NEC
nec.description: NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered in Minato, Tokyo. It provides IT and network services such as cloud computing, AI, IoT platforms, and telecommunications equipment to businesses, communication providers, and governments. NEC is one of Japan's five largest defense contractors.

noventiq.name: Noventiq
noventiq.description: Noventiq Holdings plc is an information technology company focusing on digital transformation and cybersecurity. Headquartered in London and incorporated in the Cayman Islands, it operates in about 60 countries across Europe, Asia, Latin America, India, and the Middle East.

next-plc.name: Next plc
next-plc.description: Next plc is a British multinational retailer of clothing, footwear, and home products headquartered in Enderby, England. It operates around 700 stores across the UK, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East and provides e-commerce services. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

nikola-corporation.name: Nikola Corporation
nikola-corporation.description: Nikola Corporation was an American manufacturer of heavy-duty commercial battery-electric and fuel-cell electric vehicles headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. Founded in 2014, it was named after Nikola Tesla.

nicolet-bankshares.name: Nicolet Bankshares
nicolet-bankshares.description: Nicolet Bankshares, Inc. is a regional bank holding company based in Green Bay, Wisconsin. It is the parent company of Nicolet National Bank, which is the second largest Wisconsin-based bank.

novatek.name: Novatek
novatek.description: Novatek is Russia's second-largest natural gas producer and the seventh-largest publicly traded company globally by natural gas production volume. It is based in the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Region in West Siberia and has a head office in Moscow. The company was originally known as OAO FIK Novafininvest.

noble-energy.name: Noble Energy
noble-energy.description: Noble Energy, Inc. was a hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas. In October 2020, it was acquired by Chevron Corporation. The company operated in the petroleum industry prior to its acquisition.

navya-sas.name: Navya SAS
navya-sas.description: Navya Mobility, founded in Lyon, France in 2017, specializes in designing and building autonomous and electric vehicles. It was acquired from receivership in 2023 by Gaussin and Macnica and renamed Gaussin-Macnica-Mobility (Gama).

ndtv.name: NDTV
ndtv.description: NDTV is an Indian news media company focusing on broadcast and digital news publication. It was founded in 1984 by economist Prannoy Roy and journalist Radhika Roy. The company operates primarily in the mass media industry.

natura-cosmeticos-s-a.name: Natura Cosméticos S.A.
natura-cosmeticos-s-a.description: Natura Cosméticos S.A. is a Brazilian global personal care cosmetics group headquartered in São Paulo. It includes the Natura brand and Avon Products, operating in 73 countries worldwide. Founded in 1969, it became a public company in 2004 and is the largest Brazilian cosmetics company by revenue.

nautilus-inc.name: Nautilus, Inc.
nautilus-inc.description: Nautilus, Inc., now known as BowFlex, Inc., is an American company based in Vancouver, Washington. It develops, manufactures, and markets fitness equipment brands including Bowflex, Schwinn, and JRNY. The company changed its name from Nautilus, Inc. to BowFlex, Inc. in 2023 and sells products globally through various channels.

new-world-resources.name: New World Resources
new-world-resources.description: New World Resources Plc was a Central European producer of hard coal and coke. It operated through its subsidiary OKD, the largest hard coal mining company in the Czech Republic. The company supplied coking and thermal coal for steel and energy sectors in Central Europe.

nexity.name: Nexity
nexity.description: Nexity is a French real estate development company founded in 2000 in Paris by Stéphane Richard and Alain Dinin. It focuses on real estate development and related services. The company is headquartered in France.

nidec.name: Nidec
nidec.description: Nidec Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer and distributor of electric motors. Its products are used in hard-disk drives, electric appliances, automobiles, and manufacturing equipment. Nidec is the global market leader for spindle motors powering hard-disk drives.

nissan-shatai.name: Nissan Shatai
nissan-shatai.description: Nissan Shatai Co., Ltd. is a Japanese automobile contract manufacturer for Nissan, headquartered in Hiratsuka, Kanagawa. The company began its direct history in 1949. As of 2016, Nissan owned 45.8% of its stock.

natuzzi.name: Natuzzi
natuzzi.description: Natuzzi S.p.A. is an Italian furniture company founded in 1959 by Pasquale Natuzzi. Headquartered in Santeramo in Colle, Apulia, it designs sofas, armchairs, living room accessories, and bedroom furniture.

navan-inc.name: Navan, Inc.
navan-inc.description: Navan, Inc. is an American corporate travel and expense management company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Founded in 2015, it offers an integrated platform combining travel booking, corporate payment cards, expense reporting, and analytics worldwide.

national-western-life.name: National Western Life
national-western-life.description: National Western Life Insurance Company is an American stock life insurance company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates in the insurance industry providing life insurance products.

nong-shim-ltd.name: Nong Shim Ltd.
nong-shim-ltd.description: Nongshim Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational food and beverage company headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1965 as Lotte Food Industrial Company, it changed its name to Nongshim in 1978.

neogenomics.name: NeoGenomics
neogenomics.description: NeoGenomics Laboratories, Inc. is an American clinical laboratory specializing in cancer genetics diagnostic testing. It offers services including cytogenetics, FISH, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, anatomic pathology, and molecular genetics. The company is CLIA-certified.

nichirei.name: Nichirei
nichirei.description: Nichirei Corporation is a leading Japanese producer of frozen foods and cold storage warehousing based in Tokyo. It operates through about 80 subsidiaries worldwide and is involved in processed food, logistics, marine products, real estate, and biosciences.

nielsen-company.name: Nielsen Company
nielsen-company.description: Nielsen Holdings plc is an American media audience measurement firm operating in over 100 countries. It employs approximately 15,000 people worldwide. The company is involved in the information industry.

nextdc.name: NextDC
nextdc.description: NextDC is an Australian data centre operator headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland. It is the largest listed developer and operator of data centres in Australia, operating 17 centres domestically and one in Malaysia as of 2026.

nexon.name: Nexon
nexon.description: Nexon Co., Ltd. is a South Korean–Japanese video game developer and publisher headquartered in Japan. It specializes in live service games and has offices in South Korea, the United States, Taiwan, and Thailand.

nordex-se.name: Nordex SE
nordex-se.description: Nordex SE is a European company that designs, sells, and manufactures wind turbines. Founded in 1985, it is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, with production facilities in several countries including Brazil, India, and Spain. By the end of 2023, it had installed wind turbines with a total capacity of around 50 GW in over 40 countries.

ningbo-bird.name: Ningbo Bird
ningbo-bird.description: Ningbo Bird, also known as Bodao, is a Chinese manufacturer of mobile phones. It was the largest mobile phone vendor in China from 2003 to 2005.

norwegian-cruise-line-holdings-ltd.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd.
norwegian-cruise-line-holdings-ltd.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. is a holding company based in the United States and domiciled in Bermuda. It operates three cruise lines: Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. Combined, these subsidiaries form the third-largest cruise operator worldwide.

netmarble.name: Netmarble
netmarble.description: Netmarble Corp. is a South Korean game developer and publisher founded in 2000 by Bang Jun-hyuk. The company operates in the video game industry and is based in South Korea.

neinor-homes.name: Neinor Homes
neinor-homes.description: Neinor Homes S.A. is a Spanish real estate company headquartered in Bilbao. It specializes in the development, promotion, and management of residential properties across Spain.

nomura-group.name: Nomura Group
nomura-group.description: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company and a principal member of the Nomura Group, Japan's largest investment bank and brokerage group. It provides investment, financing, and related services globally with an emphasis on securities businesses.

nippon-sharyo.name: Nippon Sharyo
nippon-sharyo.description: Nippon Sharyo, Ltd., founded in 1896 and based in Nagoya, Japan, is a major manufacturer of rolling stock, heavy equipment, generators, special purpose vehicles, and bridges. It became a consolidated subsidiary of Central Japan Railway Company in 2008 and operated a U.S. facility in Illinois from 2012 to 2018.

nbg-radio-network.name: NBG Radio Network
nbg-radio-network.description: NBG Radio Network was a syndicated American radio network based in Portland, Oregon. Founded by John A. Holmes, it created, produced, and distributed nationally syndicated radio programs and went public in 1998.

nbt-bank.name: NBT Bank
nbt-bank.description: NBT Bank, N.A. is an American financial institution headquartered in Norwich, New York. It operates through a network of 176 banking locations across several states in the northeastern United States.

nmc-health.name: NMC Health
nmc-health.description: NMC Health was a healthcare chain and distribution business headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It operated and managed over 200 facilities in 19 countries as of 2019.

ntelos.name: nTelos
ntelos.description: nTelos, Inc. was a wireless telecommunications company and PCS provider based in Waynesboro, Virginia. It served a service area covering 5.3 million people, making it the 9th largest provider of mobile broadband in the United States as of 2013.

nvr-inc.name: NVR, Inc.
nvr-inc.description: NVR, Inc. is an American home construction company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It also operates mortgage banking and title services, primarily on the East Coast of the United States, covering 14 states and Washington, D.C.

nw-natural.name: NW Natural
nw-natural.description: NW Natural, formerly Northwest Natural Gas Company, is a publicly traded utility headquartered in Portland, Oregon. It primarily distributes natural gas and also owns water utilities, servicing customers in Western Oregon and Southwest Washington.

nakano-corporation.name: Nakano Corporation
nakano-corporation.description: Nakano Corporation is a Japanese multinational general construction contractor. It engages in design, construction, civil engineering, technical assistance, and real estate development projects for corporations, governments, and individuals.

nanjing-iron-and-steel-company-limited.name: Nanjing Iron and Steel Company Limited
nanjing-iron-and-steel-company-limited.legal_name: Nanjing Iron and Steel Company Limited
nanjing-iron-and-steel-company-limited.description: Nanjing Iron and Steel Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded steel maker based in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China. Its parent company is Nanjing Nangang Iron and Steel United Co., Ltd., a joint venture between Fosun International and Nanjing Iron and Steel Group.

listings.name: Nanjing Iron and Steel Company Limited

natera.name: Natera
natera.description: Natera, Inc. is a clinical genetic testing company based in Austin, Texas specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA testing technology. It operates CAP-accredited laboratories in San Carlos, California and Austin, Texas, focusing on women's health, cancer, and organ health.

national-presto-industries.name: National Presto Industries
national-presto-industries.description: National Presto Industries is a company founded in 1905 in Eau Claire, Wisconsin. It originally produced pressure canners and later introduced small home-use cooking appliances. The company was admitted to the New York Stock Exchange on March 3, 1969.

national-retail-properties.name: National Retail Properties
national-retail-properties.description: NNN REIT, Inc. is a real estate investment trust organized in Maryland with its principal office in Orlando, Florida. It primarily invests in restaurant properties under long-term triple net leases, often through leaseback arrangements.

national-stock-exchange-of-australia-lim.name: National Stock Exchange Of Australia Limited
national-stock-exchange-of-australia-lim.legal_name: National Stock Exchange Of Australia Limited
national-stock-exchange-of-australia-lim.description: National Stock Exchange of Australia (NSX) is a stock exchange based in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. It is owned and operated by NSX Limited, which is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since January 13, 2005. The exchange was formerly known as the Newcastle Stock Exchange.

listings.name: National Stock Exchange Of Australia Limited

nations-trust-bank.name: Nations Trust Bank
nations-trust-bank.description: Nations Trust Bank is a Sri Lankan bank regulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and governed by the Banking Act. It commenced operations in July 1999 after acquiring the Colombo branch of Overseas Trust Bank. The bank has historically focused on corporate banking but aims to become a retail-focused commercial institution.

nearmap.name: Nearmap
nearmap.description: Nearmap is an aerial technology company headquartered in Australia that provides data and insights using proprietary AI from frequently-updated, high-resolution aerial imagery. Its location intelligence covers large portions of populations in Australia, the US, New Zealand, and Canada. It was publicly traded until taken private by Thoma Bravo in 2022.

nepal-bangladesh-bank.name: Nepal Bangladesh Bank
nepal-bangladesh-bank.description: Nepal Bangladesh Bank Ltd. was a public commercial bank in Nepal established in 1994 as a joint venture with IFIC Bank of Bangladesh. It was acquired by Nabil Bank Ltd. in July 2022 and now operates under the name Nabil Bank Limited.

nepal-bank-limited.name: Nepal Bank Limited
nepal-bank-limited.description: Nepal Bank Limited is the first commercial bank of Nepal, established in 1937 by Juddha Shumsher. It marked the beginning of formal banking in Nepal and operates within the commercial banking industry.

netscout-systems.name: NetScout Systems
netscout-systems.description: NETSCOUT Systems, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Westford, Massachusetts. Founded in 1984 as Frontier Software, it specializes in software observability, deep packet inspection, DDoS mitigation, and AIOps.

netwitness.name: Netwitness
netwitness.description: NetWitness is a network security company based in Riverside, California, providing real-time network forensics, automated threat detection, response, and analysis solutions. It was acquired by EMC Corporation in 2011 and later by Symphony Technology Group in 2020.

neurocrine-biosciences.name: Neurocrine Biosciences
neurocrine-biosciences.description: Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 1992. It develops treatments for neurological and endocrine-related diseases and had its drug valbenazine approved in the US in 2017.

neuronetics-inc.name: Neuronetics, Inc.
neuronetics-inc.description: Neuronetics is a publicly traded company based in Malvern, Pennsylvania, incorporated in 2003. It develops non-invasive neuromodulation treatments for psychiatric disorders resistant to traditional medicine.

newalliance-bank.name: NewAlliance Bank
newalliance-bank.description: NewAlliance Bancshares, operating as NewAlliance Bank, was the second largest Connecticut-based savings bank. It was formed in 2004 by merging The Savings Bank of Manchester, New Haven Savings Bank, and Tolland Bank.

newfield-exploration.name: Newfield Exploration
newfield-exploration.description: Newfield Exploration Company was a petroleum, natural gas, and natural gas liquids exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It was organized in Delaware and was acquired by Encana in February 2019.

next-digital.name: Next Digital
next-digital.description: Next Digital Limited was a Hong Kong-based media company, previously known as Next Media Limited. It was the largest media company in Hong Kong before ceasing operations in 2021. Its newspaper Apple Daily was the most read in the city, and the company became defunct following legal and political actions.

nib-health-funds.name: Nib health funds
nib-health-funds.description: nib Group is an Australian health care fund established in 1952 to provide health insurance for workers at the BHP Newcastle Steelworks. It has grown into a national and international operation with a significant share of the Australian private health cover market.

nichicon.name: Nichicon
nichicon.description: Nichicon Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of various types of capacitors and one of the largest capacitor manufacturers worldwide. Headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, it was established in 1950 after separating from Nii Works Co. and adopted the Nichicon name in 1961.

nh-foods.name: NH Foods
nh-foods.description: NH Foods Ltd. is a food processing conglomerate headquartered in Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan. It operates in the food industry.

nissui.name: Nissui
nissui.description: Nissui Corporation is a marine products company based in Tokyo, Japan. It was formerly known as Nippon Suisan Kaisha Ltd. from 1937 until it changed its name to Nissui in December 2022.

nisshinbo-holdings.name: Nisshinbo Holdings
nisshinbo-holdings.description: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc. is a Japanese company with diverse businesses including electronics, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, papers, and real estate. It was formerly listed on the Nikkei 225. The company operates in various industrial manufacturing sectors.

noble-corporation.name: Noble Corporation
noble-corporation.description: Noble Corporation plc is an offshore drilling contractor organized in London, England, with an affiliate organized in the Cayman Islands. It is the corporate successor of Noble Drilling Corporation. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

noodles-company.name: Noodles & Company
noodles-company.description: Noodles & Company is an American fast-casual restaurant chain headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. Founded in 1995, it offers international and American noodle dishes, soups, and salads. The company went public in 2013 and had 458 locations across 31 states by mid-2022.

northeast-bank.name: Northeast Bank
northeast-bank.description: Northeast Bank is a full-service financial institution based in Maine, USA. It offers personal and business banking through nine branches and nationwide commercial loan services. The bank also provides online savings products via its ableBanking division.

northwest-biotherapeutics.name: Northwest Biotherapeutics
northwest-biotherapeutics.description: Northwest Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a development-stage American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Maryland. Founded in 1996 by Alton L. Boynton, it focuses on developing immunotherapies against various types of cancer.

northwest-bank.name: Northwest Bank
northwest-bank.description: Northwest Bank is a bank headquartered in Warren, Pennsylvania. It is the leading subsidiary of Northwest Bancshares, Inc., a bank holding company. The bank operates 151 branches across Pennsylvania, Western New York, Northeast Ohio, Appalachian Ohio, and Indiana.

nuscale.name: NuScale
nuscale.description: NuScale Power Corporation is an American company headquartered in Tigard, Oregon. It markets proposed designs for small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs). The company is publicly traded.

nuvasive.name: NuVasive
nuvasive.description: NuVasive, Inc. is a medical devices company based in San Diego, California. Founded in 1997, it develops medical devices and procedures for minimally invasive spine surgery.

nutrisystem.name: Nutrisystem
nutrisystem.description: Nutrisystem is a commercial provider of weight loss products and services headquartered in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania.

nxstage.name: NxStage
nxstage.description: NxStage Medical, Inc. is an American company that develops, manufactures, and markets systems for treating chronic kidney disease, acute kidney injury, and hypervolemia. It is a subsidiary of Fresenius Medical Care. Its primary product is System One, a portable hemodialysis system.

nankang-rubber-tire.name: Nankang Rubber Tire
nankang-rubber-tire.description: Nankang Rubber Tire Corp, Ltd is a Taiwanese manufacturer of automobile tires and synthetic rubber products. Its products include tires for cars, light trucks, SUVs, and snowfield vehicles. In 2006, it generated most of its revenue from automobile tires, with significant sales in the Americas and Europe.

new-world-development-company-limited.name: New World Development Company Limited
new-world-development-company-limited.description: New World Development Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based conglomerate focused on property, hotels, infrastructure, services, and department stores. Established in 1970 by Cheng Yu-tung, it has been publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1972. It was formerly part of the Hong Kong Hang Seng Index.

nyrstar.name: Nyrstar
nyrstar.description: Nyrstar is an international producer of minerals and metals founded in August 2007. It was listed on the Euronext Brussels stock exchange in October 2007.

newcrest-mining.name: Newcrest Mining
newcrest-mining.description: Newcrest Mining Limited is an Australian-based corporation engaged in exploration, development, mining, and sale of gold and gold-copper concentrate. It is Australia's leading gold mining company with operations extending internationally, including Indonesia. The company originated as a Newmont subsidiary in 1966 and took its current name in 1990.

nippon-bs-broadcasting.name: Nippon BS Broadcasting
nippon-bs-broadcasting.description: Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation is a private satellite broadcasting station based in Kanda, Tokyo, Japan. It operates the BS11 channel and is a subsidiary of Bic Camera. The company was founded in 1999 and began high-definition broadcasts in 2007.

nacon.name: Nacon
nacon.industry: Wholesale (business-to-business) of computers, computer peripheral equipment and software
nacon.description: Nacon SA is a French company based in Lesquin that publishes video games and manufactures gaming peripherals. It designs and distributes gaming accessories and video games for various platforms. In 2020, Bigben Group's gaming activities were consolidated to form Nacon.

ninety-one-plc.name: Ninety One plc
ninety-one-plc.description: Ninety One, formerly Investec Asset Management SA, is a South African investment management company founded in 1991. It is headquartered in Cape Town and listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

novonor.name: Novonor
novonor.description: Novonor, formerly Odebrecht S.A., is a Brazilian conglomerate headquartered in Salvador, Bahia. Founded in 1944, it operates in engineering, construction, chemicals, and petrochemicals across the Americas, Caribbean, Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

nizhnekamskneftekhim.name: Nizhnekamskneftekhim
nizhnekamskneftekhim.description: Nizhnekamskneftekhim is a large petrochemical company headquartered in Nizhnekamsk, Russia. It is the largest specialized petrochemical company in Europe.

nigerian-postal-service.name: Nigerian Postal Service
nigerian-postal-service.description: The Nigerian Postal Service (NIPOST) is a government-owned corporation responsible for postal services in Nigeria. It employs over 12,000 people and operates more than 3,000 post offices across the country.

national-bank-of-algeria.name: National Bank of Algeria
national-bank-of-algeria.description: Banque Nationale d’Algérie is a state-owned commercial bank headquartered in Algiers, Algeria. It is a leading bank in the country, providing financial services to private customers, companies, and public institutions. The bank is active in financing industry, agriculture, and foreign trade.

nokian-tyres.name: Nokian Tyres
nokian-tyres.description: Nokian Tyres plc is a Finnish tyre manufacturer based in Nokia, Finland. It produces tyres for various vehicles and is known for having the only permanent winter tyre testing facility in the world.

netsuite.name: NetSuite
netsuite.description: NetSuite Inc. is an American cloud-based enterprise software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It provides software products and services for small and medium-sized businesses, including accounting, CRM, and e-commerce. Founded in 1998, it was acquired by Oracle in 2016.

newag.name: Newag
newag.description: Newag S.A. is a Polish company based in Nowy Sącz specializing in the production, maintenance, and modernization of railway rolling stock. Its products include electric multiple units and prototype trams, and it collaborates with Siemens Mobility on metro train assembly.

netia.name: Netia
netia.description: Netia is a Polish telecommunications company owning the second-largest fixed-line cable television and broadband network in Poland. Founded in 1990, it was listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange in 2000.

namibia-breweries-limited.name: Namibia Breweries Limited
namibia-breweries-limited.description: Namibia Breweries Limited is a brewery founded in 1920 and based in Windhoek, Namibia. In April 2023, Heineken completed the purchase of the company. It operates in the brewery industry.

norwegian-property.name: Norwegian Property
norwegian-property.industry: Renting and operating of own or leased real estate
norwegian-property.description: Norwegian Property is a real estate company with a portfolio in Oslo and Stavanger, Norway. Founded in 2006 and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange, it invests in major commercial real estate and offers a publicly traded real estate portfolio.

nofar-energy.name: Nofar Energy
nofar-energy.description: Nofar Energy is an Israeli renewable energy company headquartered in Kfar Saba. It develops, finances, constructs, owns, and operates renewable energy and energy storage projects, focusing on solar photovoltaic generation and battery storage.

nordgold.name: Nordgold
nordgold.description: Nord Gold S.E. (Nordgold) is a gold mining company with assets in Russia, Kazakhstan, Burkina Faso, Guinea, and Canada. The company operates internationally in the gold mining sector.

net.name: NET
net.description: NET was a Brazilian telecommunications company offering cable television, broadband internet, and telephony services. Owned by América Móvil, the NET brand was absorbed into the Claro brand in 2019 and discontinued in 2022.

nex-group.name: NEX Group
nex-group.description: NEX Group plc, formerly ICAP plc, is a UK-based business focused on electronic financial markets and post-trade services for financial institutions. It operates BrokerTec and EBS, major treasury and foreign exchange markets. NEX was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by CME Group in 2018.

norway-royal-salmon.name: Norway Royal Salmon
norway-royal-salmon.description: Norway Royal Salmon ASA was a Norwegian fish farming company headquartered in Trondheim with a sales office in Kristiansand. After nearly 30 years, it merged with SalMar in 2022, with SalMar acquiring its assets and operations. Its trading activities became part of Visscher Seafood Group.

national-post.name: National Post
national-post.description: The National Post is a Canadian English-language broadsheet newspaper and the flagship publication of the American-owned Postmedia Network. It is published Monday through Saturday and distributed in several Canadian provinces. It is one of Canada's two national newspapers.

nv-energy.name: NV Energy
nv-energy.description: NV Energy is an investor-owned public utility based in Las Vegas, Nevada. It generates, transmits, and distributes electric service in northern and southern Nevada and provides natural gas service in the Reno-Sparks area. The company serves about 1.3 million customers and many tourists annually.

nomad-foods.name: Nomad Foods
nomad-foods.description: Nomad Foods is the largest frozen food company in Europe, headquartered in the United Kingdom. It manufactures, sells, and distributes frozen food products across 22 European markets, with popular brands including Birds Eye, Iglo, and Findus.

nidec-asi.name: Nidec ASI
nidec-asi.description: Nidec Industrial Solutions is an Italian multinational company based in Milan that designs and manufactures rotating electrical machines, power electronics, and industrial automation. Founded in 2012 after Nidec Corporation acquired Ansaldo Sistemi Industriali, it serves markets including petrochemical, energy, steel, marine, and industrial automation.

netezza.name: Netezza
netezza.description: IBM Netezza is a subsidiary of IBM that designs and markets high-performance data warehouse appliances and advanced analytics applications. Its products support enterprise uses including data warehousing, business intelligence, predictive analytics, and business continuity planning.

nayax.name: Nayax
nayax.description: Nayax Ltd. is an Israeli fintech company providing cashless payment, telemetry, management, monitoring, and business intelligence products for vending and unattended retail industries.

neftekamsk-automotive-plant.name: Neftekamsk Automotive Plant
neftekamsk-automotive-plant.description: Neftekamsk Automotive Plant is a Russian manufacturer of buses and machinery built on KamAZ chassis. The company is located in Neftekamsk, Bashkortostan, and specializes in bus production.

novosibirskenergo.name: Novosibirskenergo
novosibirskenergo.description: OJSC Novosibirskenergo was an electric power company based in Novosibirsk Oblast, Russia. It was involved in power generation, transfer, and distribution services.

national-iranian-oil-company.name: National Iranian Oil Company
national-iranian-oil-company.description: The National Iranian Oil Company is a government-owned oil and natural gas producer and distributor in Iran, operating under the Ministry of Petroleum. Established in 1951 and restructured in 1954, it is the world's second largest oil company after Saudi Aramco.

national-bank-of-canada.name: National Bank of Canada
national-bank-of-canada.description: The National Bank of Canada is the sixth largest commercial bank in Canada, headquartered in Montreal. It has branches across most Canadian provinces and serves 3.1 million clients. It is the largest bank in Quebec and the second largest financial institution in the province after Desjardins.

nl-industries.name: NL Industries
nl-industries.description: NL Industries, formerly the National Lead Company, is a lead smelting company based in Dallas, Texas. It was one of the 12 original stocks included in the Dow Jones Industrial Average at its creation in 1896.

n-brown-group.name: N Brown Group
n-brown-group.description: N Brown Group plc is an online retailer headquartered in Manchester, England. It offers clothing, footwear, and homewares, focusing on underserved customer groups. The company was taken private by the Alliance family in February 2025.

namhae-chemical-corporation.name: Namhae Chemical Corporation
namhae-chemical-corporation.description: Namhae Chemical Corporation is a large South Korean company producing fertilizers and chemicals. Established in 1974, it is headquartered in Yeosu, Jeollanam-do, with a branch office in Jung-gu, Seoul.

napatech-a-s.name: Napatech A/S
napatech-a-s.description: Napatech is a Danish public company that develops and manufactures high speed network accelerators designed for real-time network monitoring and analysis. Its products are used across industries including financial services, telecom, cloud, e-commerce, and defense.

netmanage.name: NetManage
netmanage.description: NetManage Inc. was a software company based in Cupertino, California, founded in 1990 by Zvi Alon. It had a development center in Haifa, Israel, and was acquired by Micro Focus International in 2008.

norbord.name: Norbord
norbord.description: Norbord Inc. was a Canadian company that manufactured wood-based panels and was the world's largest producer of oriented strand board (OSB). It also produced particleboard and medium-density fibreboard. Norbord operated 17 plants in the United States, Canada, and Europe.

northwestern-energy.name: NorthWestern Energy
northwestern-energy.description: NorthWestern Energy Group, Inc. is a utility company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, serving South Dakota, Nebraska, and Montana. It has corporate headquarters in Sioux Falls and South Dakota operations headquarters in Huron. The company provides utility services to approximately 718,000 customers.

north-american-palladium.name: North American Palladium
north-american-palladium.description: North American Palladium Ltd. was a Canadian mining company operating from 1968 to 2019. It primarily mined palladium and also gold, platinum, silver, nickel, and copper as by-products. The company operated the Lac des Iles mine in Ontario and was acquired by Impala Platinum in 2019.

north-drilling.name: North Drilling
north-drilling.description: North Drilling Company is an Iranian company specializing in drilling oil and gas wells and providing related services globally. It was privatized in June 2009, and as of 2010, a quasi-government investment company owned 20% of its shares on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

northland-power.name: Northland Power
northland-power.description: Northland Power is a Canadian-owned global power producer founded in 1987. It develops, owns, and operates a diversified mix of energy infrastructure assets including wind, solar, natural gas, and battery storage. The company also supplies energy through a regulated utility.

noveko-international.name: Noveko International
noveko-international.description: Noveko International was a Canadian corporation based in Boucherville, Quebec. It produced antimicrobial air filters, surgical masks, respirators, hand sanitizers, and portable ultrasound machines. The company held a patent for its antimicrobial technology and was involved in a legal dispute with former employees.

national-iranian-petrochemical-company.name: National Iranian Petrochemical Company
national-iranian-petrochemical-company.description: The National Petrochemical Company (NPC) is an Iranian government-owned entity responsible for developing and operating Iran's petrochemical sector. Founded in 1964, it began with a small fertilizer plant in Shiraz and operates under the Iranian Petroleum Ministry.

nouvelle-air-affaires-gabon.name: Nouvelle Air Affaires Gabon
nouvelle-air-affaires-gabon.description: Nouvelle Air Affaires Gabon is an airline based in Libreville, Gabon. It provides corporate and freight charter services. Its main base is Libreville International Airport.

new-millenium-air.name: New Millenium Air
new-millenium-air.description: New Millennium Air Company was a Gambian airline based in Banjul, The Gambia. It operated as an airline within the country.

national-oil-corporation.name: National Oil Corporation
national-oil-corporation.description: The National Oil Corporation (NOC) is Libya's national oil company dominating the country's oil industry. It oversees several subsidiaries, including the Waha Oil Company, Arabian Gulf Oil Company, Zueitina Oil Company, and Sirte Oil Company. It is led by Farhat Bengdara since July 2022.

namibia-airports-company.name: Namibia Airports Company
namibia-airports-company.description: The Namibia Airports Company is a state-owned enterprise managing eight of the largest airports in Namibia. It operates under the Ministry of Public Works and Transport and is a member of the Airports Council International.

nampower.name: NamPower
nampower.description: Namibia Power Corporation, known as NamPower, is the national electric power utility company of Namibia. It is responsible for electricity generation, transmission, and distribution, regulated by the Electricity Control Board of Namibia.

namibia-red-cross-society.name: Namibia Red Cross Society
namibia-red-cross-society.description: The Namibia Red Cross Society is a humanitarian organisation headquartered in Windhoek, Namibia. It was founded in 1991 by an Act of Parliament and became a member of the International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in 1993. It was formerly part of the South African Red Cross Society.

niger-poste.name: Niger Poste
niger-poste.description: Niger Poste is the government organisation responsible for the postal service in Niger. The country is a member of the West African Postal Conference. Niger Poste manages mail services across Niger.

niger-telecoms.name: Niger Telecoms
niger-telecoms.description: Niger Telecoms is the national telephone and telecommunications carrier of Niger, created in 2016 by merging SONITEL and SahelCom. The company was renationalised due to financial difficulties and operates telecommunications services across Niger.

niger-airlines.name: Niger Airlines
niger-airlines.description: Niger Airlines is the Nigerien flag carrier headquartered in Niamey and based at Diori Hamani International Airport. It serves as the national airline of Niger.

nigeria-lng.name: Nigeria LNG
nigeria-lng.description: Nigeria LNG Limited (NLNG) is a company producing liquefied natural gas and operates an LNG plant located on Bonny Island, Nigeria. It is involved in the liquefied natural gas sector.

nigerian-red-cross-society.name: Nigerian Red Cross Society
nigerian-red-cross-society.description: The Nigerian Red Cross Society was founded in 1960 and has its headquarters in Abuja. It operates as an emergency and relief organization in Nigeria.

nigerian-telecommunications.name: Nigerian Telecommunications
nigerian-telecommunications.description: Nigerian Telecommunications Limited (NITEL) was a monopoly telephone service provider in Nigeria until 1992. It was formed in 1985 by merging two government entities and was state-owned, with sub-par performance during and after its monopoly.

nigerian-library-association.name: Nigerian Library Association
nigerian-library-association.description: The Nigerian Library Association (NLA) is a professional organization for librarians and information science educators in Nigeria. Established in 1962, it is headquartered in Abuja and promotes cooperation and advocacy for libraries nationwide.

nile-breweries-limited.name: Nile Breweries Limited
nile-breweries-limited.description: Nile Breweries Limited is the leading beer manufacturer in Uganda. It operates within the brewing industry in the country.

netco.name: Netco
netco.description: North Eastern Telecommunications Company is a telecommunications firm established in 1993 in Bosaso, the commercial capital of Puntland, a federal regional state of Somalia. It provides telecom services in the region.

nationlink-telecom.name: NationLink Telecom
nationlink-telecom.description: NationLink Telecom is a telecommunications company based in Somalia. It operates within the country's telecom industry.

nova-airways.name: Nova Airways
nova-airways.description: Nova Airways is a passenger airline based in Khartoum, Sudan. It was formerly known as Nova Airlines from 2006 to 2011. The airline is currently banned from EU airspace.

nairobi-stock-exchange.name: Nairobi Stock Exchange
nairobi-stock-exchange.description: The Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) was established in 1954 as the Nairobi Stock Exchange and is based in Nairobi, Kenya. It began as a voluntary association of stockbrokers registered under the Societies Act in British Kenya. The exchange had 66 listed companies as of February 2021.

national-airways-ethiopia.name: National Airways Ethiopia
national-airways-ethiopia.description: National Airways Ethiopia, formerly Air Ethiopia, is a private airline based in Addis Ababa. Established in 2007, it has been operating charter services since 2009.

national-investment-bank.name: National Investment Bank
national-investment-bank.description: National Investment Bank (NIB) is a state-owned commercial bank in Ghana focused on promoting industrialization. It is licensed by the Bank of Ghana and has undergone restructuring to improve its financial standing. The bank supports various sectors of the Ghanaian economy.

neiva.name: Neiva
neiva.description: Indústria Aeronáutica Neiva is a subsidiary of Embraer producing airplanes and aircraft components in Brazil. Its main product is the Embraer EMB 202 Ipanema, the most used agricultural aircraft in Brazil and the first alcohol-powered airplane.

neobus.name: Neobus
neobus.description: Neobus is the tradename of Brazilian bus manufacturer San Marino Ônibus e Implementos Ltda, based in Caxias do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul. Since starting production in 1996, Neobus has manufactured over 30,000 vehicles including microbuses, intercity, and touring coaches. Its primary manufacturing plant is located in Caxias do Sul.

netshoes.name: Netshoes
netshoes.description: Netshoes is a Brazilian e-commerce sporting goods conglomerate established in 2000. It operates distribution centers in Brazil and manages official online stores for various soccer clubs and brands. It also represents the NBA in Latin America.

national-beef-packing-company.name: National Beef Packing Company
national-beef-packing-company.description: National Beef Packing Company LLC is a beef processor headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, USA. Owned by Brazilian multinational Marfrig, it produces fresh and processed beef products worldwide. It is one of the major beef packers in the United States.

nando-s.name: Nando's
nando-s.description: Nando's is a South African multinational fast casual restaurant chain specializing in Portuguese flame-grilled, peri-peri style chicken. The name comes from a nickname for Fernando, one of the company's founders.

nedbank.name: Nedbank
nedbank.description: Nedbank Group is a South African financial services group offering wholesale and retail banking, insurance, asset management, and wealth management. Nedbank Limited is its wholly-owned subsidiary.

nissan-south-africa.name: Nissan South Africa
nissan-south-africa.description: Nissan South Africa is an automotive company based in Centurion, Gauteng. Founded in 1966, it is a subsidiary of the Japanese automaker Nissan. The company operates within South Africa's automotive industry.

norse-air.name: Norse Air
norse-air.description: Norse Air is a South African charter airline headquartered in Sandton, Johannesburg, and based at Lanseria International Airport. It operates in the airline industry.

national-airways-corporation.name: National Airways Corporation
national-airways-corporation.description: National Airways Corporation (NAC) is a commercial aviation company headquartered at Lanseria Airport in Johannesburg, South Africa. It offers aircraft sales, maintenance, parts, charter, pilot training, and international operations. NAC operates multiple offices across South Africa and has a shareholding in a US-based company.

neotel.name: Neotel
neotel.description: Neotel, formerly SNO Telecommunications, was South Africa's second national operator for fixed line telecommunication services. Unveiled in 2006 in Midrand, it was the first direct competitor to the state-owned Telkom.

nimble-giant-entertainment.name: Nimble Giant Entertainment
nimble-giant-entertainment.description: Nimble Giant Entertainment, SA is an Argentine video game developer located in Buenos Aires. The studio was acquired by Saber Interactive in 2020. It operates in the video game industry.

naranja-x.name: Naranja X
naranja-x.description: Naranja X is an Argentine fintech company headquartered in Córdoba and Buenos Aires.
