Founded in 1985, it offers a variety of financial services including loans and credit cards within its ecosystem. The company operates primarily in the financial services sector in Argentina.

nostromo-defensa.name: Nostromo Defensa
nostromo-defensa.description: Nostromo Defensa is a defense contractor headquartered in Córdoba, Argentina. Founded in 2006, it develops unmanned aerial vehicles for military and non-military applications. The CEO of the company is Marcelo Martínez.

norwegian-air-argentina.name: Norwegian Air Argentina
norwegian-air-argentina.description: Norwegian Air Argentina S.A.U. was an Argentine low-cost airline operating Boeing 737-800 aircraft. Its bases were in Buenos Aires and Córdoba, and all aircraft were registered in Argentina.

nexa-resources.name: Nexa Resources
nexa-resources.description: Compañía Minera Atacocha, known as Atacocha, is a Peruvian mining company focused on exploration and exploitation of mine concessions. Since 2009, it operates under Nexa Resources Atacocha and is listed on the Peruvian exchange.

national-society-of-industries.name: National Society of Industries
national-society-of-industries.description: The National Society of Industries (Sociedad Nacional de Industrias - SNI) is a private organization that unites the business community of the Peruvian manufacturing industry.

national-commission-of-telecommunication.name: National Commission of Telecommunications
national-commission-of-telecommunication.description: The National Commission of Telecommunications is a Venezuelan government agency responsible for regulating, supervising, and controlling telecommunications in the country.

ntn24.name: NTN24
ntn24.description: NTN24 is a Colombian cable television news channel owned and operated by RCN Televisión. It operates within the journalism and media sector in Colombia.

national-report.name: National-Report
national-report.description: National-Report is a Colombian company that tracks music singles popularity charts based on radio play. It monitors data in Colombia, Venezuela, and Ecuador, providing weekly chart rankings.

national-bank-of-bolivia.name: National Bank of Bolivia
national-bank-of-bolivia.description: Banco Nacional de Bolivia S.A. (BNB) is a Bolivian bank and financial institution headquartered in Sucre, Bolivia. Founded in 1871, it is one of Bolivia's oldest banks and the country's second largest bank by total assets.

nile-news.name: Nile News
nile-news.description: Nile News is an Egyptian state-funded Arabic-language news television network headquartered in 6 October, Giza. Founded in 1998 as a 24-hour news network, it gained popularity in the Arab world for its journalistic professionalism.

national-bank-of-egypt.name: National Bank of Egypt
national-bank-of-egypt.description: National Bank of Egypt S.A.E. is a major Egyptian bank founded in June 1898. It is the country's largest bank by assets, deposits, loans, capital, branches, and employees, ranking among the big five banks in Egypt.

new-century-production.name: New Century Production
new-century-production.description: New Century Production is an Egyptian film production company established in 2004 by Walid Al Kurdi. It is a new production branch of Dollar Film, which was originally founded in 1949. The company operates in the film industry.

nile-air.name: Nile Air
nile-air.description: Nile Air is an Egyptian airline based at Cairo International Airport operating scheduled services to destinations in Egypt, the Middle East, the Persian Gulf, Southern Europe, Asia, and Africa. It is the largest private airline in Egypt and the second largest overall. Nile Air operates a fleet of Airbus A320-200s and A321-200s.

nature-air.name: Nature Air
nature-air.description: Nature Air was a regional airline headquartered in San José, Costa Rica, offering scheduled and charter services to destinations in Costa Rica, Panama, and Nicaragua. It claimed to be the world's first carbon neutral airline and ceased operations in January 2018 following a fatal accident.

nmb-bank-plc.name: NMB Bank Plc
nmb-bank-plc.description: NMB Bank Plc is a commercial bank in Tanzania licensed by the Bank of Tanzania, the national banking regulator.

national-agricultural-bank.name: National Agricultural Bank
national-agricultural-bank.description: Banque Nationale Agricole (BNA) is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia. It is listed on the Bourse de Tunis and serves the banking sector within the country.

nouvelair.name: Nouvelair
nouvelair.description: Nouvelair is a Tunisian airline with its registered office in Tunis and head office in Monastir. It operates tourist charter flights from European cities to Tunisian holiday resorts. Its main bases include airports in Monastir, Tunis, and Djerba.
